## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `credit_settings` | `object` | no | Credit policy for this customer: an override of what happens when credit is used up (ignored after `override_expires_at`), and an overdraft limit per currency. Replaced whole; null = the business's settings. |
| `credit_settings.on_exhausted` | `string` | no | What happens when the credit is used up, for a business with blocking on. Null = not set here. One of `block`, `bill`. |
| `credit_settings.override_expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | The override expires time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `credit_settings.overdraft_limit_minor` | `object` | no | Per currency (`{"USD": 500}`). |
| `id` | `string` | no | Choose the customer's id instead of a generated `cus_…`. Unique within the business: an id already in use returns 409. |
| `email` | `string` | no | The customer's email address. |
| `first_name` | `string` | no | The ACCOUNT HOLDER. With last_name/company this is how a customer is named — there is no flat `name` field: sending one returns 400. |
| `last_name` | `string` | no | The customer's last name. |
| `company` | `string` | no | The customer's company name. |
| `currency` | `string` | no | The customer's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `address` | `object` | no | The customer's address. |
| `address.line1` | `string` | no | First line of the address. |
| `address.city` | `string` | no | The city. |
| `address.state` | `string` | no | The state or region. |
| `address.postal_code` | `string` | no | The postal code. |
| `address.country` | `string` | no | The country (ISO-3166 alpha-2 code). |
| `tax_exempt` | `boolean` | no | Short-circuits tax to 0 with reason customer_exempt |
| `email_notifications` | `boolean` | no | false stops automatic billing emails to this customer. Emails an operator sends explicitly still go out. Default true. |
| `dunning_excluded` | `boolean` | no | true excludes this customer from dunning: a failed payment does not start dunning, and invoices already in dunning get no further retries or reminders. The first automatic payment attempt on a new invoice still runs. Time does not pass for dunning while the customer is excluded: setting false resumes dunning on those invoices, and every remaining retry, reminder and final action moves later by the length of the exclusion. Default false. |
| `exclude_from_reporting` | `boolean` | no | true leaves this customer out of every metric and report: MRR, churn, revenue, payments, analytics and exports. Use it for internal and test accounts. Billing is not affected. A change restates the stored figures in the background. Default false. |
| `billing_cc_emails` | `array of string` | no | Addresses copied (CC) on this customer's invoice, receipt and credit note emails, in addition to contacts with `send_billing_email`. Default empty. |
| `billing_bcc_emails` | `array of string` | no | Addresses blind-copied (BCC) on this customer's invoice, receipt and credit note emails. Default empty. |
| `tax_behavior` | `string` | no | Whether this customer's prices include tax. Set, it applies to every taxed line on the customer's invoices, whatever the price says. Default null: each price decides. One of `inclusive`, `exclusive`. |
| `dunning_policy` | `string` | no | The dunning policy (dpol_…) for this customer's invoices. Absent or null: the business dunning settings. dunning_excluded still applies first. |
| `vat_number` | `string` | no | B2B / reverse-charge registration number |
| `withholding_rate_bps` | `integer` | no | TDS: payer withholds this % of the net base (1000 = 10%) |
| `custom_fields` | `object` | no | Custom-field values; or pass top-level cf_&lt;name&gt; params |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `credit_settings` | `object` | Credit policy for this customer: an override of what happens when credit is used up (ignored after `override_expires_at`), and an overdraft limit per currency. Replaced whole; null = the business's settings. |
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `email` | `string` | The customer's email address. |
| `name` | `string` | DERIVED, read-only (deprecated 2026-08-23): `first_name last_name`, else `company`, else null. There is no `customer.name` any more — sending this field to create or update returns 400. It is emitted only so a caller has a flat display string. Two distinct identities exist and neither is derived from the other: `first_name`/`last_name`/`company` are the ACCOUNT HOLDER (lists, emails, portal greeting), while `address.first_name`/`last_name`/`company` are the BILLING CONTACT, which is what gets printed on invoices and credit notes and sent to the gateway as the billing name. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency the operator pinned on the customer, if any. Prefer effective_currency when deciding what to transact in. |
| `effective_currency` | `string` | DERIVED, read-only: the currency to transact in — `currency` when the operator set one, else the currency of the customer's live (active/in_trial) subscriptions, highest MRR winning a tie. Emitted by GET (detail) and by the list; absent from create/patch/archive responses. Null when there is nothing to derive from — fall back to the business default. Never write it back to `currency`. |
| `lifetime_revenue` | `array of object` | DERIVED, read-only: cash collected from this customer, one entry per currency — succeeded payments minus succeeded refunds. Credits applied to invoices are not cash and are excluded. Emitted by GET (detail) only. |
| `tax_exempt` | `boolean` | True if the customer is exempt from tax. |
| `email_notifications` | `boolean` | Whether the customer gets billing emails. |
| `marketing_opt_in` | `boolean` | The customer's answer to the marketing opt-in at checkout. Null when they were never asked. |
| `marketing_opt_in_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The marketing opt in time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `dunning_excluded` | `boolean` | True if the customer is excluded from dunning. |
| `exclude_from_reporting` | `boolean` | True if the customer is left out of metrics and reports. |
| `billing_cc_emails` | `array of string` | Addresses copied on the customer's invoice and receipt emails. |
| `billing_bcc_emails` | `array of string` | Addresses blind-copied on the customer's invoice and receipt emails. |
| `tax_behavior` | `string` | Whether every taxed line for this customer is inclusive or exclusive. Null = each price decides. One of `inclusive`, `exclusive`. |
| `dunning_policy` | `string` | The customer's dunning policy. |
| `vat_number` | `string` | The customer's VAT number. |
| `withholding_rate_bps` | `integer` | The withholding rate on the customer's payments, in basis points (100 = 1%). |
| `custom_fields` | `object` | Stored custom-field values; also flattened onto the object as cf_&lt;name&gt; |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid body |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "maya@example.com",
    "first_name": "Maya",
    "last_name": "Castillo"
  }'
```
